name: align-formatter-rewrite
description: One captured Claude edit (e1 rewrites the last line). Afterwards, with no captured edit, a formatter rewrites the file: indentation changes, spacing around operators changes, and the one-line `for` is split in two. Rule 8 applies rule 5 between the replayed state and `final`. Only the two `def` lines occur exactly once and unchanged on both sides, so they keep base. Every other line exists only because of the rewrite, including `return tally(rows) / max(len(rows), 1)`, which e1 wrote but the formatter changed: it is Unknown(noCapture), never e1, because the final line is not the line e1 wrote.
